_note: Text for snapshots (the lab notebook), in ASD-STE100. {n}, {parts}, {wires} and {level} are filled in by the app.

save.heading: Save a snapshot
save.text: A snapshot keeps this board in your lab notebook. You can open it later and look at it in 3D.
save.title: Title
save.notes_hint: What did you learn? What went wrong?
save.no_board: This browser has no saved board for this level. Open the level and save the snapshot there.

errors.level: Select the level of this board.
errors.title_empty: Write a title. For example: Ears wired.
errors.title_long: The title is too long. Use 80 characters or fewer.
errors.notes_long: The notes are too long. Use 2000 characters or fewer.

list.heading: Lab notebook
list.text: Your saved boards. Search them, filter them and sort them.
list.empty: No snapshots yet. In build mode, press Save snapshot to keep your board here.
list.empty_starred: No starred snapshots yet. Press the star on a snapshot to keep it here.

page.view_only: View only. Turn the board to look at it. Point at a hole to see what it connects to.
page.delete_text: You cannot undo this. The snapshot and its stars go away.
page.broken: This snapshot has a board that the app cannot read.

stars.failed: We could not change the star. Try again.

find.label: Find snapshots
find.search_hint: Words in the title or the notes
find.none: No snapshot agrees with your search and filters.

share.heading: Share this build
share.text: Send a friend a link. They can look at your board in 3D. They do not need an account, and they cannot change anything.
share.switch: Anyone with the link can see this build
share.off: The link is off. No one can open it.
share.failed: We could not change the sharing. Try again.

shared.not_shared_text: The owner turned the link off, or the build does not exist.
